title: The Halfway Diner
world: You are the new night-shift server at the Halfway Diner, a 24-hour diner on an empty desert highway. Dot, the night cook, has rules for the hours between 2 and 4 AM. Customers who walk in after 2 AM are not always customers.

parts.title: The Halfway Diner - Part 1
parts.summary: You start your first night shift at the Halfway Diner. night-cook (Dot) gives you three rules: cook every order and never ask who placed it, never tell a customer your name, and at 3:33 stay behind the counter. Then she says 'same as last night, hon', though it is your first shift. trucker (Hank) sits at his stool without touching his food. pajama-kid (Theo) walks in barefoot at 2 AM and calls you by name. An order prints for empty booth four, the coffee you pour vanishes, and the customer counter reads four when you can only count three. At 3:33 the-driver arrives with a delivery for 'the server', asks your name while Theo urges you to tell him, the lights die, and the Driver ends up behind the counter with you. He hands you a receipt that already has your signature on it from last night. Cliffhanger: 1 = sign the receipt, 2 = tear open the bag.
